name: qwencloud-video-generation
title: QwenCloud Video Generation
description: Generate video from text or images with Wan models on QwenCloud - shot prompts, durations, and async output handling.

steps.instruction: Confirm the shape: text-to-video or image-to-video; use the Wan 2.x route via the qwen-mm media tools.
Write shot-style prompts: subject, motion, camera, lighting - keep clips at 5s while iterating.
For image-to-video supply one clean keyframe and describe the motion relative to it.
Submit and poll: video generation is async, so never block the chat turn waiting for it.
On failure capture the API error verbatim - quota and content-filter rejections need different fixes.
Deliver the output with its file path and a one-line description; surface the cost per clip.
